title: Heena
desc: Heena's love life is a rollercoaster-marriage to Sameer, divorce, then a new start with Akram. But drama unfolds as Ruby re-enters, complicating their relationships.

title: Saugandh
desc: Ganga, seeking revenge on Sarang-the man who wiped out her family-vows that her son will marry Sarang's daughter to crush his pride and make him feel her pain.

title: Jayantabhai Ki Luv Story
desc: Simran, a young engineer new to Mumbai, moves into a tough area. Jayantabhai, a small gangster, helps her and falls in love, but her father disapproves.

title: Laali Ki Shaadi Mein Laaddoo Deewana
desc: Laddoo, an ambitious middle-class man, falls for Laali, but their joy is cut short when they discover she is pregnant, throwing their love and future into turmoil.

title: Madaari
desc: After losing his son due to government negligence, Nirmal kidnaps the home minister's ten-year-old son. He demands justice and forces the administration to face his painful revenge.

title: Toilet: Ek Prem Katha
desc: Keshav marries Jaya and adores her, but their happiness falters when she protests the lack of a toilet at home. As tensions rise, he struggles to appease her with temporary fixes.

title: Pardes
desc: Kishorilal chooses Ganga for his NRI son. But Ganga shares a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son, leading to a conflict between duty and love.

title: Aatma - Feel It Around You
desc: The story revolves around a single mother, who fights against the vengeful spirit of her deceased husband in order to protect her daughter.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Prem Deewane
desc: Radha and Manohar elope after her father opposes their love, unaware that her uncle-pretending to support them-harbors sinister plans of his own.

title: Jaal: The Trap
desc: Ajay is forced to kidnap Anita, the home minister's daughter, to save his girlfriend Neha from terrorists. But during the mission, he uncovers a shocking truth.

title: Traffic Signal
desc: Silsila, a street-smart young man who manages various trades at a Mumbai traffic signal, sees his life crumble when he unknowingly helps execute a murder.

title: Laila Majnu
desc: Qais and Laila fall in love in Kashmir but face family opposition. Fate separates them-Laila marries another man while Qais moves to London, heartbroken.

title: Robot 2.0
desc: In Chennai, When Dr Vaseegaran And His Humanoid Robot, Nila, Are Summoned To Help Save The City From The Destructive Pakshi Rajan, A Bird-Shaped Being, He Reinstates Chitti.

title: Murder 2
desc: Arjun, a former cop, takes on the case of missing sex workers. To catch the culprit, young Reshma bravely steps in as bait-risking everything to expose the truth.

title: Mukkabaaz
desc: Aspiring boxer Shravan Singh clashes with Bhagwan Das Mishra, the powerful head of a boxing federation. Matters escalate when Shravan falls for Bhagwan's niece, Sunaina.

title: Goodbye
desc: A family unravels after the sudden death of the mother. As the children rush home for her final rites, clashing opinions ignite tensions, exposing deep-rooted conflicts.
